title: Sunheir Orthopedic Dog Bed for Medium, Large and Extra Dogs, with Removable Waterproof Cover Egg-Crate Foam, Pet Machine Washable (Grey), L(36''X27''X3'')

reviews.title: Average quality
reviews.body: I bought this bed for my young puppy because it was advertised as anti chew. Unfortunately she ripped the side within the first hour, so the bed didn't last long. Also the size is slightly smaller than advertised. The price wasn't too expensive so I guess was worth what i paid for
reviews.author: Anna Y.

reviews.title: Good catch, go for it!
reviews.body: Good quality at this price, large size and comfortable. Time will test how long it lasts.Good for large sized dogs. I will be sitting in it too with the dogs!
reviews.author: Priya Shekhar

reviews.title: Comfortable bed, perfect size!
reviews.body: This bed is great quality and doesn’t have any odor. We bought it a few months ago and it still looks like new. Easy to clean, the zipper is strong and smooth and my 55 lb boxer loves how soft and comfortable it is.  I highly recommend
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 21 July 2026
reviews.author: Kindle Customer

reviews.title: Generous and thick.
reviews.body: There is a generous depth of foam filling and a snug, washable cover. My dog loves this bed, and it fits her nighttime crate to perfection. I would buy it again. May not suit a breed that dug a lot the cover may not stand up to that type of wear.
reviews.author: Jacquie Humphrey

features: WARM PLUSH SURFACE - The dog bed is designed with a luxury plush Sherpa top and a slip-resistant bottom, providing extra coziness for dogs to sleep comfortably
WATERPROOF & MACHINE WASHABLE COVER - Removable cover that’s machine washable for quick cleaning up. It is recommended to clean up in time to protect the health of the dog
RELIEVE STRESS WITH EGG-FOAM - The orthopedic dog beds filled with 3 inch thick egg foam, to help dog relieve pressure on the spine, muscles, and joints when resting and relaxing on the pet bed

DESIGNED FOR PETS - Rectangle shaped mattress is perfect for pets to stretch out when its sleep. It also can be placed on living room, any elevated dog bed & dog bed trampoline or in a crate & pet house
ABOUT PACKAGING - PLEASE NOTE that the pack was compressed,we suggest putting it for 48 hours to best status after openning
